name: 林鈞陶
objective:
此課程主要是含蓋無線通訊基頻訊號處理的理論基礎與系統架構，大部分的課程內容會以目前熱門的多輸入多輸出 (MIMO) 傳輸為背景而進行探討。

This course provides the fundamental theories and architectures for baseband wireless communications. Much attention will be focused on the multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) transmission.
課程進度(1-16週):
(subject to change based on class progress)
Week 1: Introduction.
Week 2-3: Linear Algebra and Matrix Computations (Review).
Week 4-6: Single-Antenna Wireless Communications. 
Week 7: Midterm I.
Week 8-10: Spatial Multiplexing and Receiver Design.
Week 11-12: Space-Time Coding.
Week 13 Midterm II.
Week 14-16: Other MIMO Transceivers (Optional) and Final Project.
彈性學習(17-18週):
類別
		  
		    ● 參與課程相關作業、作品、實驗、田野調查 (Participation in course-related assignments, works, experiments, or field research)
